question: A shopkeeper cheats 25% in weight while buying rice and cheats 25% while selling it. If he sells the rice at 12 (1)/(2) % profit, then find his net profit percentage.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Net Multiplier = (100 + Buy Cheat%) / (100 − Sell Cheat%) × (100 + Profit%) / 100

Net Multiplier = (125 / 75) × (112.5 / 100)

Net Multiplier = (5 / 3) × (9 / 8) = 15 / 8 = 1.875

Net Profit = 1.875 − 1 = 0.875

**∴ The correct option is A.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Buying cheat = 25% | Selling cheat = 25% | Stated Profit = 12.5%

**Formula Used:**

Effective Profit Multiplier = (Actual Weight Received / Price Paid Weight) × (Price Charged Weight / Actual Weight Delivered) × (1 + Profit%)

 
 Buy: 125g
 Get 25% Extra
 
 
 Sell: 75g
 Give 25% Less
 
 
 Profit: 12.5%
 On Price

 
• 
 
• 
 
 Net Profit Factor = (125/75) × 1.125
 Total Multiplier = 1.875

Let the cost price of 1000g be Rs. 1000 (1g = Rs. 1).

⇒ While buying, he gets 1250g for Rs. 1000.

⇒ Effective CP per gram = 1000 ÷ 1250 = Rs. 0.8

⇒ While selling, he gives only 750g but charges for 1000g.

⇒ Selling Price charged = 1000 + 12.5% of 1000 = Rs. 1125

⇒ Effective SP per gram sold = 1125 ÷ 750 = Rs. 1.5

⇒ Profit per gram = SP − CP = 1.5 − 0.8 = 0.7

⇒ Profit percentage (in decimals) = Profit ÷ CP = 0.7 ÷ 0.8

⇒ Profit = 0.875

**∴ The correct answer is 0.875.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Dishonest Dealer Formula

Profit % = [(True Weight − False Weight) ÷ False Weight] × 100. If price is also marked up, combine using the multiplier method.

Multiplier Method for Successive Changes

Final Value = Initial Value × M₁ × M₂ × M₃. Here, multipliers are calculated for each cheating and profit instance.

Buying vs Selling Cheat

Cheating x% while buying means getting (100+x) for 100. Cheating x% while selling means giving (100−x) while charging for 100.</p
